key_insight: MDSKILL proposes multi-view distillation to turn an agent’s textual skill memories into knowledge internalized by its policy. The goal is more efficient self-improvement despite noisy, redundant, or conflicting memories.
problem_solved: Directly distilling self-generated skill memories is difficult because useful guidance can be mixed with noise and entangled or contradictory knowledge.
method: Encode past agent experiences as textual skill memories that guide learning.
Use on-policy self-distillation to learn from skill-guided trajectories through dense, fine-grained supervision alongside reinforcement learning.
Apply multi-view distillation to internalize skill memory; the supplied abstract is truncated and does not specify the views or implementation details.
impact: The approach could help practitioners train self-improving agents more efficiently by converting reusable experience into policy knowledge. The supplied excerpt contains no experimental results, so performance gains cannot be assessed.
visual_elements: Learning loop: agent experience → textual skill memory → guided trajectories → policy update.

paper_title: MDSKILL: Learning to Internalize Skill Memory through Multi-View Distillation for Efficient Dynamic Agent Self-Evolution
paper_authors: Dian Jin, Jinluan Yang, Kairong Han, Baohong Li, Zijing Hu
